Select canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units. Source assays, activities, compound_structures, molecule_dictionary. Join assays to activities on assay_id. Join activities to molecule_dictionary on molregno. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. Filter assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1217643'. Filter activities.standard_relation = '='. Filter activities.standard_value IS NOT NULL. Filter activities.standard_relation IS NOT NULL. Sort by canonical_smiles ASC, molecule_chembl_id ASC, standard_type ASC, standard_relation ASC, standard_value ASC, standard_units ASC.
